content: Lepran desǝ nǝ put a nsar fen ngunan, dǝm pee waa Gayus ɗe, ɗe wen wal nwaa nɗǝǝn zeen.
Shaar fen, wen kǝ ɗangnaan mbǝ nwaa, mbǝkǝ a kat ɗeret ɗe nɗǝǝn mbii mo jir, kǝzak, mbǝkǝ a tong ɗe nkoom, kaaɗe seen fwaa nǝ kat ɗeret sǝ.
Nǝ ret nwen nyit zam, kaaɗe pak ɗyemnǝǝn fun mo jì satpwoo ɗeret nwen nkaa waa nǝnee, aa ɗar ɓalɓal nɗǝǝn shinzeen nǝ, kǝ kaaɗe aa mwaan nɗǝǝn shinzeen nǝ sǝ zak.
Baa mee retnyit ɗe wen ɗǝ nǝ waa met nɗesǝ kas, kǝ wen kǝlǝng nnǝ, jep fen moo mwaan a nɗǝǝn shinzeen nǝ.
Shaar fen, aa ɗar ɓalɓal nɗǝǝn zeen ɗe aa cìn nǝ mbǝ dyemnǝǝn fun nendǝm nɗang Jesu mo, jir kǝ ɗǝ mo mǝzep mo.
Mo kǝ satpwoo Eklisiya mo nkaa wal fwa nǝ. Kuzuk a ɓam mo nɗǝǝn mwaan mo, nkaa ar ɗǝ nǝ shin ɗǝɗes Naan ɗi.
Mbǝɗe mo yool yaa mwaan nǝ a mbǝ sǝm kǝ Daa. Baa mo nwaa lap mee ɓam pee neen kùm mo kas.
Mbǝmǝnǝ, nǝ ret kǝ mun mu lap nen mǝnǝ mo nɗǝǝn lu fun mo, mbǝkǝ mu ɗee ɗe a shaar ɗak ɗi ashak nɗǝǝn zeen.
wen kǝn ran mee mbii Eklisiya nǝ, ɗang Diyoturifis ɗe wur fes leshin a ɗi nshee, wur bǝ kaat mun kas.

Katɗang wen jì, ɓǝ wen ndul ɗiyen fuu shinji kaa bii ɗe wur nkaa cin ne, Pwoo ɗebuu ɗe wur naa nsat nǝ nkaa mun. Baa mǝnǝ mak wur kas, ɗang wur cii kaat pak nen dǝmdang Jesu, wur cíi nnen ɗe moo pǝ rǝɓet kaat mo kǝ wur put ke mo nɗǝǝn Eklisiya ne
Sharfen, taji a kam cin bii ɗǝ bish mo kas, Ɗangɓe a kam a ɗeret mo. Koo a weyii ɗe wur cìn mbii ɗeret, ɓǝ gwar mǝnǝ a mǝ Naan. Jir ngwe ɗe wur cìn mbii ɗebish, baa gwar mǝnǝ kǝ naa Naan kas koo lee.
Gurum mo jir mo satpwoo ɗeret nkaa Dimitiriyus, har zeen nǝ shikáa fir. Mun zak muu sat dǝret nkaa wur. waa man nǝnee, mbii camkat fun nǝ azeen.
Wen kǝ mbii mo ɗes mbǝ ran mo ngha, ɗang baa an nran mo ngha a shi haal kǝ ing kas.
Wen kǝ lepan nǝ, an naa ngha, ɗangɓǝ mun leshap kǝ shak yit kǝ yit.
Tongriyang ashak kǝ wun. Shaar ɗǝ pee ɗǝsǝ mo lep kǝ tokshik. Tokshik kǝ shaar ɗǝ peemenǝ mo shi sǝm.
